snippet.title: Being Food - Official Reveal Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Here's a look at the Reveal Trailer for Being Food, a third-person abstract puzzle platformer developed by Hot_____Dog_. Players will embody a cute bird named Oolahla in what starts seemingly like a normal bird day. Something is different about today, though... Do you know what it takes to be a bird? Will you survive the bird day? Being Food is coming soon to PC (Steam).
